title: Earth and Environment
parentNote: This unit covers our planet, weather, seasons, and environmental awareness. Important for understanding our world!
learnBullets: Know about our planet **Earth** and its features
Understand **day and night** and why they happen
Know about **water bodies** — rivers, oceans, lakes
learnItFirst:
**1. Our Planet Earth**

- Earth is the **third planet** from the Sun
- Earth is also called the **Blue Planet** (because of water)
- Earth has **one moon**
- Earth **rotates** (spins) causing day and night
- Earth **revolves** around the Sun causing seasons

**2. Four Seasons**

| Season | Weather |
|--------|--------|
| Summer ☀️ | Very hot |
| Monsoon/Rainy 🌧️ | Lots of rain |
| Autumn 🍂 | Leaves fall |
| Winter ❄️ | Very cold |

**3. Water Bodies**

- **River** — flowing fresh water
- **Lake** — still fresh water surrounded by land
- **Ocean/Sea** — large salt water body
- **Pond** — small water body

**4. Keep Environment Clean**

- Don't throw garbage on roads
- Plant trees
- Save water
- Reduce, Reuse, Recycle

questions.content: Earth is also known as the ___.
questions.why: Earth is called the Blue Planet because most of it is covered with water

questions.content: How many seasons are there in a year?
questions.why: There are 4 main seasons: Summer, Monsoon/Rainy, Autumn, and Winter

questions.content: We get rain from ___.
questions.why: Rain falls from clouds in the sky

questions.content: Which season is very hot?
questions.why: Summer is the hottest season

questions.content: What causes day and night?
questions.why: Earth rotates (spins) on its axis, causing day and night

questions.content: Which season is very cold?
questions.why: Winter is the coldest season

questions.content: Trees give us ___.
questions.why: Trees release oxygen which we need to breathe

questions.content: What do we see in the sky at night?
questions.why: At night, we can see the moon and stars in the sky

questions.content: A river contains ___ water.
questions.why: Rivers have fresh water (not salty like the ocean)

questions.content: We should not throw garbage ___.
questions.why: We should not throw garbage on roads — put it in the dustbin

questions.content: Earth is the ___ planet from the Sun.
questions.why: Earth is the third planet from the Sun (Mercury, Venus, Earth...)

questions.content: Which water body is very large and has salty water?
questions.why: Oceans are very large bodies of salty water

questions.content: In which season do we get lots of rain?
questions.why: Monsoon or rainy season brings lots of rain

questions.content: What should we do to save trees?
questions.why: We should plant more trees to save our environment

questions.content: How many moons does Earth have?
questions.why: Earth has one natural moon

questions.content: Pollution is harmful to ___.
questions.why: Pollution is harmful to humans, animals, and plants — all living things

questions.content: The Sun rises in the ___ and sets in the ___.
questions.why: The Sun rises in the East and sets in the West

questions.content: Which gas do we breathe in?
questions.why: We breathe in oxygen, which is essential for life

questions.content: What makes smoke and dirty air?
questions.why: Vehicles and factories release smoke and cause air pollution

questions.content: In autumn season, leaves ___.
questions.why: In autumn, leaves change colour and fall from trees

questions.content: We can save water by ___.

options.A: Turning off taps when not in use

questions.why: Turn off taps when not in use to save water

questions.content: A rainbow appears after ___.
questions.why: A rainbow appears when sunlight passes through raindrops after rain

questions.content: Which is the largest ocean in the world?
questions.why: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean in the world

questions.content: What should we do with plastic bottles after use?
questions.why: We should recycle plastic to reduce pollution

questions.content: World Environment Day is celebrated on ___.
questions.why: World Environment Day is celebrated on 5th June every year

questions.content: Earth Day is celebrated on ___.
questions.why: Earth Day is celebrated on 22nd April every year

questions.content: What percentage of Earth is covered with water?
questions.why: About 70% of Earth's surface is covered with water

questions.content: Which layer of atmosphere protects us from harmful sun rays?
questions.why: The ozone layer protects us from the Sun's harmful UV rays

questions.content: Planting trees helps in reducing ___.
questions.why: Trees absorb carbon dioxide and help reduce air pollution

questions.content: The hottest planet in our solar system is ___.
questions.why: Venus is the hottest planet due to its thick atmosphere that traps heat
